To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
PET modified mixes prepared using the modified dry process showed superior properties as compared to other mixes.

PET modified mixes can be prepared by both processes, but modified dry process is more effective, and that mixes containing larger PET size (2.36-1.18 mm) are more effective than mixes containing smaller size (0.30-0.15 mm) of PET.

(i) PET addition improved volumetric properties of mixes and increased stiffness, (ii) modified dry process of PET addition was found to be superior to dry process, and (iii), PET size had no significant effect on properties of PET modified asphalt mixes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a sustainable approach for utilization of waste PET bottles in asphalt mixes.
the utilization of waste PET bottles as a sustainable material for the preparation of modified asphalt mixes.
the utilization of waste PET bottles for the production of sustainable asphalt mixes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
PET modified mixes prepared using modified process, with 2.5% PET content, and PET size of 2.36–2.0 mm showed the best performance.
PET addition in dry process (with modified dry process being a better option) can be used as a cost effective and eco-friendly method to improve asphalt mixes performance.
, the modified dry process is the most effective process for incorporation of waste PET in asphalt mixes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
PET modified mixes are a promising alternative for conventional asphalt mixes and can be used in pavement construction.
the use of waste PET bottles in asphalt mixtures is a sustainable practice and could be a viable alternative to conventional aggregates.
, PET addition in asphalt mixtures is an effective way for recycling PET bottles.
The main takeaway from our work is that
PET addition to asphalt mixes can be beneficial in terms of improving the volumetric properties and moisture susceptibility.
the modified dry process can be used to incorporate waste PET bottles into asphalt mixes.
waste PET bottles can be used as a cost-effective alternative to conventional aggregates for asphalt mix design.
